1174365525750755331.a: It may seem odd to fry beef in oil. Consuming one type of fat can leave cholesterol skewed. Especially important if you have genes or meds which swing it one way or another. Beef fat, peanut, coconut, palm, olive are diverse in oils; veg/canola oil = comic levels of linoleic acid

1174366636838703105.a: Vegetable and canola oils are also high in sulfites which is a weird gene-based allergen. If you have family history of sulfa allergies or you find yourself 300, 400 pounds with asthma switch to nut and ruminant animal oils. I lost 120lbs in one year with one change in my diet.

1174369463795367938.a: If you like Popeye's chicken vs KFC, for example: (Best I can tell in a world of changing recipes, conflicting info) Popeye tends to fry food with peanut oil and beef tallow. Chik-fil-a uses peanut oil. Peanut oil will not trigger allergy as the offending proteins are not present
